assessment.summary: The records establish a diagnostic Sentinel-1-derived backscatter ratio and a decline in DSWx-HLS water-class counts over the same WGS84 AOI. An exact area-weighted native-grid overlay was completed. At the 0.75 coverage threshold, 738 cells were retained, 710 had at most 0.05 water-fraction change, and descriptive Pearson r was -0.108. The evidence does not establish a causal explanation or validated flood boundary. ANA reports that the nearby Usina do Gasômetro station remained above flood stage across the two acquisition dates; this is regional narrative context, not a timestamped series or AOI-scale water observation, and it does not resolve the cause. A same-pair polarization sensitivity check on 738 shared cells found descriptive water-change correlations of -0.108 (VV) and -0.078 (VH); these related channels do not provide independent validation. NASA GPM IMERG Final Daily provides seven sample-complete regional days before each SAR acquisition; the nearest native cell sums to 219.9 mm and 14.3 mm, respectively. This coarse precipitation context does not establish a surface driver or explain the SAR response. Across the 23 complete UTC days between the SAR acquisitions, NASA GPM IMERG estimates total 214.93 mm at the nearest ~0.1 degree cell, peaking at 77.44 mm/day on 2024-05-23. This chronology adds temporal context, not AOI soil-moisture measurement or causal evidence. NASA/USGS HLS Landsat L30 provides same-date optical context with 23.0% common clear-land AOI support; the native-grid NDVI/SAR association at 75% cell coverage is descriptive (r=-0.290) and does not distinguish vegetation causality.

test_design.mechanism_branch: Choose one measurable branch before retrieval: soil-moisture change or vegetation-state change. Do not combine distinct measurements into one driver claim.
test_design.expected_observation: An independent, quality-accepted measurement of the selected surface-state variable changes between the SAR acquisition times and shows a spatial pattern compatible with the diagnostic SAR response on explicitly compared valid support.
test_design.would_weaken_if: The selected variable is measured with suitable temporal and spatial support and quality, yet its change lacks the predicted association with the SAR response. This weakens only that selected mechanism branch.
test_design.inconclusive_if: Either date is missing, quality fails, the acquisition timing is unsuitable, the native support cannot resolve or meaningfully compare the AOI, or valid coverage is insufficient.
acceptance_gates: Identify one physical variable and its measurement semantics before retrieval.
Use an independently sourced product that does not incorporate Sentinel-1 observations or derived values.
Retain provider quality flags and require a documented acceptable disposition for the selected measurement.
Record acquisition timestamps and assess temporal offsets against both SAR acquisitions.
Compare native spatial support and valid coverage to the AOI and SAR analysis cells; do not resample incompatible data to force a match.
test_design.interpretation_limit: A compatible association may make the selected H3 mechanism branch more plausible within scope, but does not establish causation, validate the diagnostic SAR pair, or resolve other hypotheses.

processing.method: Read the exact retained source records; verify record types, shared WGS84 AOI, measurement-mask shapes and counts; summarize valid log-ratio values; when linked, validate the source checksums and summarize an exact area-weighted polygon overlay of native-grid optical cells on SAR cells without resampling; validate hypothesis predictions, weakening conditions, evidence references, and testability-state fields without deciding their scientific correctness.
